title: 3 Free Tools That Will Make You an AI Engineer Without a Degree
description:
No CS degree. No $50K bootcamp. Just 3 free open source tools that have quietly trained more working AI engineers than most university programs.

🎓 Tool 1 — The Free Course
You build actual models in lesson one before touching a single line of theory. By the end, you're doing the same work people at OpenAI and Anthropic do every day.

🤗 Tool 2 — The GitHub of AI
Over 1 million open models sitting there for you to download, fine-tune, and deploy for free — plus their own free courses on LLMs, agents, and reinforcement learning.

⚡ Tool 3 — Fine-Tune Your Own Model
Run it on a free Google Colab notebook in about 2 hours. Companies used to spend tens of thousands of dollars in GPU time to do what this repo does for basically the price of your internet bill.

Three tools. Zero excuses.

Comment "Engineer" and I'll DM you the links to all three 👇

#AIEngineer #FreeAITools #LearnAI #OpenSourceAI #HuggingFace #FineTuning #AIForBeginners #MachineLearning #LLM #GoogleColab #AICareer #NoDegree #AITools #AIProductivity #Shorts
